**6B.9 Research Note: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, 2024**

Overall reading: **moderately positive**. Lula’s 2024 record shows multiple attempts to embed policy in rules, ministries, councils, monitoring systems, and formal decrees rather than personal discretion. The main caveat is durability: several reforms are recent and could still be weakened after his tenure, so the evidence is stronger on **institution-building intent and design** than on proven long-run survival.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| Positive | [Decree 12.064](https://www.presidencia.gov.br/Ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12064.htm) | Presidência da República | 2024-06-17 | https://www.presidencia.gov.br/Ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12064.htm | Bolsa Família was tied to health and education conditionalities with shared monitoring across ministries, which makes the program less dependent on Lula personally and more durable as a rules-based institution. | 6B.9, 6B.7, 6B.8 |

| Positive | [As assessorias criadas pelo presidente devem fortalecer participação social nas políticas públicas do governo federal](https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/marco/assessorias-criadas-pelo-presidente-devem-fortalecer-participacao-social-nas-politicas-publicas-do-governo-federal) | Secretaria-Geral da Presidência | 2024-03-05 | https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/marco/assessorias-criadas-pelo-presidente-devem-fortalecer-participacao-social-nas-politicas-publicas-do-governo-federal | Lula created participation/diversity offices across ministries, which institutionalizes civic voice inside the state apparatus rather than relying on personal leadership alone. | 6B.9, 6B.8 |
| Positive | [Conselho Nacional de Política Indigenista é reaberto com cerimônia de posse no Palácio da Justiça](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/conselho-nacional-de-politica-indigenista-e-reaberto-com-cerimonia-de-posse-no-palacio-da-justica) | Ministério dos Povos Indígenas | 2024-04-16 | https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/conselho-nacional-de-politica-indigenista-e-reaberto-com-cerimonia-de-posse-no-palacio-da-justica | Restoring the National Council of Indigenous Policy rebuilt a consultative institution that can survive changes in administration and protect Indigenous participation. | 6B.9, 6B.8 |
| Positive | [SNAVE decree](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm) | Presidência da República | 2024-04-24 | https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm | SNAVE created a standing national system to monitor and combat school violence, which is a durable administrative architecture rather than a one-off policy announcement. | 6B.9, 6B.8, 6B.6 |
| Positive | [Governo federal cria fóruns de participação social para atuar nos territórios](https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/dezembro/governo-federal-cria-fóruns-de-participação-social-para-atuar-nos-territórios) | Secretaria-Geral da Presidência | 2024-12-16 | https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/dezembro/governo-federal-cria-fóruns-de-participação-social-para-atuar-nos-territórios | Territorial social-participation forums broadened local voice and added an institutional layer that can persist beyond Lula’s personal office. | 6B.9, 6B.8 |
| Positive | [Regula Melhor](https://www.gov.br/mdic/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/agosto/governo-lanca-a-estrategia-nacional-de-melhoria-regulatoria/) | MDIC | 2024-08-21 | https://www.gov.br/mdic/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/agosto/governo-lanca-a-estrategia-nacional-de-melhoria-regulatoria/ | The regulatory strategy grounds rulemaking in evidence, transparency, participation, and periodic review, which is exactly the kind of institutionalization that outlives a single ruler. | 6B.9, 5B.7 |
| Positive | [Novo PAC Seleções](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura) | Casa Civil | 2024-03-07 | https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura | Large capital spending was routed through sectoral programs and low-coverage areas, building service capacity through line ministries rather than through Lula’s personal network. | 6B.9, 6B.8, 6B.7 |
| Positive | [Novo PAC Seleções](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/julho/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-41-7-bi-em-transporte-drenagem-esgotamento-sanitario-abastecimento-de-agua-e-infraestrutura-social-nas-cidades) | Casa Civil | 2024-07-26 | https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/julho/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-41-7-bi-em-transporte-drenagem-esgotamento-sanitario-abastecimento-de-agua-e-infraestrutura-social-nas-cidades | Formal investment pipelines for sanitation, drainage, water, and social infrastructure strengthen institutional delivery capacity beyond any single term. | 6B.9, 6B.8, 6B.7 |
| Positive | [Lula’s government expands disability-care network](https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/dezembro/saiba-mais-sobre-as-acoes-do-ministerio-da-saude-voltadas-as-pessoas-com-deficiencia) | Ministério da Saúde | 2024-12-03 | https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/dezembro/saiba-mais-sobre-as-acoes-do-ministerio-da-saude-voltadas-as-pessoas-com-deficiencia | Expansion of rehab centers and adapted transport suggests sectoral institutional capacity, not ad hoc personal rule. | 6B.9, 6B.8 |
| Negative / caveat | [Brazil’s government eyes initiatives to boost credit for low-income individuals](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/brazils-government-eyes-initiatives-to-boost-credit-for-lowincome-individuals-3342513) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-18 | https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/brazils-government-eyes-initiatives-to-boost-credit-for-lowincome-individuals-3342513 | Eligibility-based access is better than patronage, but the article shows a still-centralized, executive-driven welfare architecture rather than fully autonomous institutions. | 6B.9, 6B.7 |
| Negative / caveat | [Ministro das Comunicações é indiciado pela PF por corrupção...](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm) | Reuters via UOL | 2024-06-12 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm | A politically connected minister tied to public-works diversion suggests patronage/capture still existed inside Lula’s coalition, weakening the durability-cleanliness picture. | 6B.9, 6B.7, 6B.8 |
| Negative / caveat | [Brazil: Mixed Rights Record for Lula’s First Year](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/brazil-mixed-rights-record-lulas-first-year) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/brazil-mixed-rights-record-lulas-first-year | HRW says Lula made progress, but police abuse and unequal protection persisted, especially for Black Brazilians, so institutional gains were not yet fully durable in practice. | 6B.9, 6B.8, 6B.6 |
| Negative / caveat | [Brazil looks at curbing health, education spending in fiscal package, sources say](https://www.investing.com/news/forex-news/brazil-looks-at-curbing-health-education-spending-in-fiscal-package-sources-say-3703870) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/forex-news/brazil-looks-at-curbing-health-education-spending-in-fiscal-package-sources-say-3703870 | Fiscal pressure threatened core social spending, which is a durability risk for the institutions Lula built in 2024. | 6B.9, 6B.6, 6B.8 |

Search gap: I found **strong evidence of institution-building**, but not proof yet that these institutions would survive a post-Lula political transition. That limitation is structural to a 2024-only lens. The best-supported claim is that Lula **built more durable social institutions than a purely personalist ruler would**, but their long-run resilience remains untested.
